fr.elements: Main Residence; Detached Structure; Open Lawn Area; Access Drive; Landscaped Area; Dense Vegetation
fr.considerations: Single Access Point; Dense Vegetation; Limited Rear Access; Open Terrain
fr.recommendations:
• Install a reflective address marker at the driveway entrance so responders can identify the property quickly from the road.
• Mark the single driveway entrance clearly on both sides to help responders locate access in low-visibility or nighttime conditions.
• Keep the access drive clear of parked vehicles and stored equipment to allow fire apparatus and emergency vehicles to reach the residence and detached structure without obstruction.
• Trim vegetation along both sides of the access drive so large emergency vehicles can pass without branches blocking mirrors, windows, or equipment.
• Cut back dense vegetation near the detached structure to give responders a clear path around all sides of the building.
• Thin dense vegetation between the main residence and the detached structure so responders can move directly between the two buildings.
• Identify and mark any rear access points to the property so responders are not limited to the single front entry during an emergency.
• Keep a gate or opening in any rear fence or perimeter barrier unlocked and clearly marked to allow responders to reach the rear of the property on foot.
• Mow or maintain the open lawn area so it can be used as a staging area for equipment and personnel.
• Mark the locations of any utility shutoffs on the exterior of the main residence and detached structure so responders can find them without searching.

wildfire.conditions: Scattered Shrubs; Grass Cover; Scattered Trees; Open Terrain; Brush Area; Limited Vegetation Separation; Single Access Route; Vegetation Along Driveway; Large Trees; Woody Debris; Mixed Vegetation; Adequate Vegetation Separation
wildfire.recommendations:
• Remove woody debris visible near structures to reduce ignition risk close to the buildings.
• Thin shrubs in the brush area to create open gaps between plants and nearby structures.
• Trim branches from large trees that hang directly over or near rooflines and structures.
• Clear grass and low vegetation within the immediate area surrounding structures before dry season.
• Cut back mixed vegetation growing along the driveway to keep at least one vehicle width of clear space on each side.
• Trim overhanging tree branches along the driveway to allow emergency vehicles to pass without obstruction.
• Remove shrubs and brush growing directly against or touching any structure on the property.
• Thin scattered trees near buildings so their branches do not touch or overlap each other close to structures.
• Keep the single access route free of fallen branches, debris, and encroaching vegetation at all times.
• Remove dead grass and dry plant material from areas where limited separation exists between vegetation and structures.
• Cut back brush area growth on the side of any structure where vegetation is closest to the building.
• Pick up and remove any accumulated woody debris from beneath large trees near the house.
